title: ReclassifyResponse
description: Response emitted by `sqlite-graphrag reclassify --json` on stdout as a single JSON line.

truncated.description: GAP-SG-142: raised by the agent-native surface whenever it removed data from this envelope.

count.description: Number of entities whose type was updated by this operation.

description_updated.description: Present and true when --description was applied in single mode.

namespace.description: Namespace in which the reclassification was performed.

matched_targets.description: Entities matching `--from-type`, counted BEFORE the update. Present ONLY in `--batch` mode; skipped on the wire for the single-entity form, which is why the closed root validated that one while rejecting the batch (GAP-SG-291). It exists so a caller can tell a real batch from one whose `--from-type` was a typo, now that the vocabulary is open and clap cannot catch that.
